import { BlogPostLayout } from '@/components/blog/BlogPostLayout'

export const article = {
  title: 'Stub post whose export lists no authors',
  description: 'Fixture for an authors list that only appears in the body.',
  date: '2026-01-05',
  tags: ['Engineering'],
}

export default (props) => <BlogPostLayout article={article} {...props} />

The byline list is configured in code like this:

```js
const post = {
  authors: [{ name: 'David Barroso' }],
}
```
